name: Flier

text.trigger: A player has a survivor at the colony.
text.vignette: A gust at dawn drops leaflets across the yard, each one printed on the same sun-faded orange paper and carrying the same bleak headline. Nobody argues; nobody reads further. You fold yours in half and tuck it into a pocket with everything else you cannot do anything about.

notes: src: Crossroad_cards_v1.1.xlsx.txt card #51; The BGG sheet gives this card a trigger and a story but no option text, so it is a flavour card: both options do nothing.
